summary: Siskiyou County lookout on a summit above Scott Valley; Forest Service lookout in 1947; NHLR-registered 2016; current status and access unresolved.

facts.agency: California Department of Forestry & Fire Protection
facts.status_note: Brief lists standing, but no source read confirms it. An undated trip report found a lookout at the summit closed up, either for good or for the season. Firelookout.org tags the site FFLOS (former-sites register).

access.note: Undated trip report: east approach gated for private property and no trespassing about a mile before the summit; west approach has a locked gate about half a mile short of the lookout. Visiting permission not found.

events.note: Ray Arnold, lookout on Quartz Hill for the Forest Service (Siskiyou Daily News, July 8, 1947); the item cites a Klamath National Forest official

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Brief says standing. No source read confirms it. Firelookout.org tags the site FFLOS, and the trip report is undated. Not resolved; the story says status is unclear.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register has no Built field and no other source read gives a build date or builder. The July 1947 item names Ray Arnold as a lookout on Quartz Hill for the Forest Service and quotes a Klamath National Forest official; it does not name the forest Arnold worked for, so the story does not say so. The register names CDF as administrator. Status 'standing' from the brief is unverified: the firelookout.org list tags the site FFLOS and its status column did not extract. Access comes from one undated trip report, so gates may have changed. A search snippet listed a 1958 Klamath National Forest lookout inventory held at Southern Oregon University (sou.libraryhost.com); not read, not used. Suggest checking the Quartz Hill row in the firelookout.org California list before publication.
